company.name: BOREAL NORGE AS
company.summary: BOREAL NORGE AS is a private limited company (aksjeselskap) registered under passasjertransport med rutebil (NACE 49.310), based in Stavanger, founded 1999-06-15. Its verified website describes it as: “Boreal er et ledende nasjonalt konsern innen kollektivtransport. Vi kjører busser, trikker, hurtigbåter og ferger.” Public brand: Boreal. Registered activity: Eie transportvirksomhet, samt virksomhet som står i forbindelse med dette. Latest filed accounts (2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31, company accounts): revenue NOK 143.6 m, operating result NOK -11.3 m, net result NOK 33.8 m, total assets NOK 826.1 m, equity NOK 780.0 m. The period closed with a profit. Change from 2024 to 2025: revenue went from NOK 92.3 m to NOK 143.6 m (+56%); net result went from NOK -444.7 m to NOK 33.8 m; equity went from NOK 755.3 m to NOK 780.0 m (+3%). Financial position in 2025: operating margin -7.9%; equity ratio 94.4%. Calculated from the filed figures above. Registered employees: 100. Leadership in the official register: Nikolai Knudsmoen Utheim (managing director); Joakim Dyrstad Halvorsen (chair of the board); Nikolai Knudsmoen Utheim (board member); Katrine Voll (board member); plus 1 further role. 18 registered workplaces in Alta, Bardufoss, Finnsnes, Hafrsfjord, Halden, Hammerfest and more. Official website https://www.boreal.no/forside/ (identity check: legal name and registered phone). Latest company-published activity: “Rute - 350 - MåsøyXpressen. Forsinkelse 12.11” (2026-11-12). Most recent registry event: Registered employee count updated (2026-11-12). Not established from checked sources: company-owned social profiles (not available); active job ads (not available). Missing information is not treated as zero.
